title: Pod Salt Nexus Blueberry Blackberry Lemonade 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Blueberry Blackberry Lemonade by Pod Salt Nexus masterfully combines the tart edge of Lemonade with juicy Blueberries and Blackberries. The outcome is a revitalising drink-inspired vape, making every inhale feel like a sip from a chilled glass on a hot afternoon. With a generous 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in every bottle, shortfill bottles from Pod Salt Nexus are designed for those who crave more of their favourite flavours. Additionally, they offer an extra 20ml space for a duo of nicotine shots, putting you in the driver’s seat when it comes to personalising your nicotine strength. To achieve 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to the 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and you've crafted your ideal shortfill. The brilliance of shortfills lies not only in their larger volumes but also in their economical value. Enhanced with a higher VG content, these e-liquids work seamlessly with high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring an impeccable balance of flavour and vapour. Elevate the longevity and pleasure of your vaping routine by opting for these larger volume Shortfills. Pod Salt Nexus prides themselves on an unparalleled selection of shortfill e-liquids. Their meticulously crafted flavours, covering a spectrum from Fruits and Desserts to Drinks and Candy, and many uniquely enticing flavours found nowhere else, are a testament to their commitment to quality and flavour. As you explore the offerings of Pod Salt Nexus, every bottle is an invitation to discover a new favourite in the vast world of vaping.
